cd /workspace/dev && timeout 900 python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import random, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
from netnomos.learners.exact import discover_clauses
U = 65536; full_u = (1 << U) - 1
rng = random.Random(11)
def um(d):
    m = int.from_bytes(rng.randbytes((U+7)//8), 'little') & full_u
    return m
def tm(N, d):
    bits = 0
    for i in range(N):
        if rng.random() < d: bits |= 1 << i
    return bits
worst = 0
for N in (2000, 10000):
    for d in (0.7, 0.8, 0.9, 0.95, 0.99):
        P = 32
        T = [tm(N, d) for _ in range(P)]
        Um = [um(0.5) for _ in range(P)]
        t = time.time(); rules = discover_clauses(T, Um, list(range(N)), U, 4); dt = time.time()-t
        worst = max(worst, dt)
        print('N=%-6d d=%.2f -> %.2fs rules=%d' % (N, d, dt, len(rules)))
print('worst %.2fs' % worst)
PYEOF
